mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.5% (relative to historical averages) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based deterioration in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals a manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines from prior month and INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market indicated by PAYEMS above 137,000 (current level) reduces consumer uncertainty and supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 137,000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate above 2.5% annually signals potential central bank tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPI > 2.5%), a further increase in the federal funds rate signals higher discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPI > 2.5%)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises from prior month and CPI > 2.5%.
